subject: ClearSight — technical ops / architecture deep-dive availability
messages:
From: Alex Sanchez <alex.sanchez@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@clearsighthealth.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after discovery — technical ops deep-dive

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the discovery call yesterday. We'd like to move toward a technical deep-dive with our cloud and security teams to validate network requirements, data paths, and how Redwood would sit inside our VPC. Key goals:
- Confirm inbound/outbound firewall rules and egress expectations
- VPN / PrivateLink options and encryption at rest/in transit
- Expected instance types for recommended throughput (we expect bursts around 200 concurrent sessions)
- Data residency and logging options (audit logs, retention)

Who from your side should join? We can do next week for 60–90 minutes; our suggested windows (PST):
- Wed Aug 4, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Aug 5, 13:00–14:30

Also attaching a brief network diagram and our security questionnaire for context.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Sanchez
Lead Cloud Engineer | ClearSight Health
[a] +1 (415) 555-0123
[attachment: ClearSight_network_requirements_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Sanchez <alex.sanchez@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@clearsighthealth.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after discovery — technical ops deep-dive

Alex —

Appreciate the clear list. We should definitely bring a platform engineer and someone from our security/compliance team. Proposed internal attendees: Jordan Blake (Platform Engineer), Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineering).

Draft agenda (60–75 minutes):
1) 10 min — introductions & scope of deep-dive
2) 20 min — network/topology review (Alex to walk through attached diagram)
3) 20 min — deployment modes & security controls (Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
4) 15 min — throughput/cost tradeoffs, instance sizing, KV cache behavior under burst
5) 10 min — action items / next steps (MVP rollout options + POC ask)

We can do Wed Aug 4, 10:00–11:15 PST (fits your first window) — Jordan and Marissa are available then. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read: our "redwood_prelim_agenda.docx" and a one-page teardown of port/IP requirements.

Two quick asks so we come prepared:
- Could you confirm whether you prefer Private (VPC) or Dedicated for the POC? If undecided, flag any blockers for Private (e.g., air-gapped requirements).
- Any special compliance artifacts we should bring (SOC2 controls mapping, data flow diagrams)?

If you need a different slot, we can shift to Thu Aug 5 afternoon as backup.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — Wed 10:00 PST works for our cloud folks, but our security lead has a conflict and asked whether we could move to Thu Aug 5, 13:00–14:30 PST instead. Would that conflict with anyone on your side? If Jordan or Marissa are not available, is there a backup engineer who can cover the network + deployment questions?

Also, our security team would like to see the SOC2 mapping and a note on encryption key management (KMS/HSM). We can share our questionnaire beforehand — attaching a short list of clarifying questions.

Thanks,
Priya

Priya / Alex —

Thu Aug 5, 13:00–14:30 PST works for our team. Jordan confirmed availability; Marissa will join for the first 45 minutes and then drop if needed. I'll send a calendar invite to everyone with the updated agenda and include the SOC2 controls mapping and a short note on our KMS options.

Pre-reads I'll attach to the invite:
- Redwood SOC2-controls-mapping.pdf
- KMS-options-and-key-rotation-notes.pdf
- redwood_prelim_agenda.docx (already shared)

If you prefer Private deployment for the POC, flag it in the invite — Jordan will prepare notes on tunnel vs PrivateLink patterns and expected latency tradeoffs.

Confirming action items:
- Vanessa: send updated invite, attach pre-reads, include Zoom link + dial-in.
- Alex/Priya: confirm attendee list and whether Private is a hard requirement for POC.
- Jordan: bring deployment topology examples and sizing guidance.

See you Thu — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
